# Femi Orimoloye

> People Strategy. Organizational Performance. Lasting Impact.

Femi Orimoloye is a strategic human-capital and people-strategy professional whose documented work spans human-capital leadership, total rewards, compensation and benefits, workforce planning, talent development, employee experience, HR operations and programme development.
